_about: Stability of vanilla EVoC vs DiReEVoC under growing N, measured as the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) of the shared 100k-point anchor set as N grows 100k -> 1M. Wikipedia embeddings have no ground-truth labelling, so ARI here is self-consistency (each method judged against itself), not agreement with class labels. Produced by experiments/stability.py on a single NVIDIA GH200 over Cohere/wikipedia-2023-11-embed-multilingual-v3 (English), 1024-d. Values transcribed from the documented run; across-N entries are reported as ranges over the consecutive 100k->250k->500k->1M steps with a representative value used for plotting.
